name: Boss3_Create

Mode 0x007DC6F1: scene 0x0B -> 0, 0x0D -> 1, 2 -> 2 (game type 3: scene != 0xF)

name: Boss3_IntroHeadInit
notes: Variant 0: skeleton 0x49, motion 0x5A (scene 0xB) / 0x5B, flags | 0x88000, +0x1340 = 15; 0x007DC6F4 = obj; -> 0x00423050

name: Boss3_IntroHeadTask
notes: Follows the body 0x007DC7F0 (RotY 0x6400 (0, 3, 55.5), +0x1340 *= 0.95) while the body is in state 2; state 3: dives with it, ends after 0x28 frames

name: Boss3_BodyInit
notes: Variant 1: motion 0x23D, shadow floor query, flags | 0x8000, node cb 0x004208F0; 0x007DC72C = obj, 0x007DC7F0 = pos, 0x007DC800 = yaw; -> 0x00420550

name: Boss3_BodyTask

name: Boss3_HeadInit
notes: Variant 2 (record s16 +0x22 = index 0..4): 0x007DC6F4[i]; hp 45 (30 in mode 2); 0x77C4-byte block +0x1390 {+0 / +0x6C / +0xD8 extra node angles x / y / z, +0x597 node count, +0x598 head node, +0x599 / +0x59A jaw nodes, +0x59B idle count, +0x59C attack count, +0x59D side, +0x5A4 z sum, +0x7628 attack table, +0x7634 idle table, +0x7638 flinch motion, +0x763A death motion, +0x763C hit tick, +0x7640 breath counter, +0x7648 intro timer, +0x764A ready (-1 idle / 0 picked)}; head 2 skeleton 0x48 (counted as attacker / live enemy), others 0x49; heads 0 / 4 motion 0x58; lock-on slot direct (0x00408E80); -> 0x004209B0

name: Boss3_HeadTask
notes: Head: shots (damage only on the head node with the jaw open > 0x1700 and the neck not turned 0x1700..0xC000, never head 2 in modes 0/1: 45 / 3 (/ 5 two players) hp, bar = total / 180, level + 1, flinch / death; else 0x1216A9 + spark 0x004247D0), skeleton, chain 0x00421F20 (states 4..6), draw 0x004219E0, phase machine 0x007DC738 (intro 0x00422D30 for heads 0 / 4; fight: idle / switch side / attack state 5 with Player_TakeHit at the hit tick; scheduler on head 2: countdown, 0x00421910(4) picks a head, rand interval), lock-on point 0x007DC7E0 lerped 0.15 to the head node

name: Boss3_RockInit
notes: Variant 3 (index = record s16 +0x22): 0x007DC72C[i], motion 0x21E, no root motion, flags | 0x88000, offsets (mode 0) rock 1 (+0.3, +2.2, +4.4) counter 0x1E, rock 0 (-2.2, +1.8, +4.3); -> 0x00420820

name: Boss3_RockTask
notes: States 0 / 1 animate; 2 (set by 0x00422D30 with a velocity): falls (vel + (0.005, -0.02722, -0.05), x / y applied), ends after 0xF0 frames

name: Boss3_Variant5Init
notes: Variant 5 (+0x131B = 8, skeleton 0x48 motion 0x42, 0x1B nodes with per-node positions); -> 0x004231C0 (other stages, not ported)

name: Boss3_Counter
notes: ++0x00811200 % (n + 1) (the boss's own pseudo-random counter; hits also add anim counter % 10)

name: Boss3_HeadSwitchSide
notes: Transition motion 0x00588F50[side], side = 1 - side, tables 0x00588EE0 / 0x00588F1C or 0x00588EF8 / 0x00588F2C, flinch 0x00588F48[ctr(1) (+1)]

name: Boss3_HeadDraw
notes: Nodes 1.. from their model-view matrices; state 5: breath models 0x97A + n % 0x27 / 0x199C + n & 31 on the second jaw node for 0x25 frames; variant-5 effects (0x004248B0 splash) not reached

name: Boss3_HeadChain
notes: States 4..6 (and 10..14 of variant 5): the node chain again with extra angles: state 5 lunge (288 - i * 144, 516 - i * 258) * t (t ramps to the hit tick and back), states 6 / 7 decay (8 - +0x1340) / 8; node matrices + view-space hit points; odd-tick root halfway to +0x12F4

name: Boss3_JawWobble
notes: Mode 2 head 2 state 4: jaw z angles by sin(+0x77B4), restarts at -300 - ctr(0x96)

name: Boss3_HeadIntro
